retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy teen pop aesthetic featuring a central portrait, 3D block lettering on a geometric badge, and organic splatter or floral vector overlays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition pairing a close-up portrait with bold, multi-colored 3D typography housed in a tilted rectangular badge, anchored by a bright orange splatter graphic and yellow floral flourishes at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
3D title badge overlaps the upper right background
Splatter graphic acts as a bottom-left anchor
Floral vector elements create a decorative bottom border
coreInvariants: 3D extruded lettering with contrasting face and depth colors
Tilted magenta rectangular background for the main title
Bright orange irregular splatter shape for secondary branding
High-saturation color palette dominated by blue, magenta, and orange

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up of a female subject, positioned slightly off-center to the left, filling most of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange splatter graphic in the bottom left corner provides a heavy visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move right to the 3D title, then down to the bottom graphic elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject, text badges, and decorative overlays.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all graphic elements; high value contrast between the dark background and bright foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D extrusion with a perspective shift
Contrasting stroke colors for the face and the depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' is often a different color (yellow) than the rest of the word
The 'C' is oversized and wraps around subsequent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair bold 3D display lettering with a small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Halftone dot patterns in the footer

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the playful, youthful energy of the original lettering.
Good base skeletons for creating custom 3D extrusions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a teenage girl in a blue hoodie against a dark, industrial-style background with metallic railings. Leave the upper right and bottom areas clear for overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a tilted magenta rectangle in the upper right with 3D rounded lettering. Place a bright orange splatter graphic in the bottom left and yellow floral vector swirls across the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the title text 3D and tilted?
Is there a prominent orange splatter in the corner?
Does the subject occupy the left side of the frame?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth on the main title
Ensure the orange splatter does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the magenta badge is tilted
Confirm the presence of yellow decorative elements at the bottom
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Tilted 3D Badge + Corner Splatter + Floral Footer = Teen Pop Aesthetic
